subject: Draft MAP: Security Gate & SOC 2 package delivery — Lumen Health
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Tom Briggs <tom@lumenhealth.com>, Karen Lee <karen.lee@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP: Security gate & SOC 2 package delivery (initial)

Hi Tom, Karen —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan focused on the security milestone we discussed. The goal here is to make the security review and SOC 2 evidence handoff a discrete, timeboxed phase so procurement and legal can complete their reviews without blocking the rest of the technical onboarding.

High-level MAP milestones (proposed):
- Milestone 1 — Security review kickoff (technical Q&A) — Responsible: Lumen (Tom) / Redwood SE (Rishi) — Target: 2027-02-28
- Milestone 2 — SOC 2 questionnaire & evidence list delivered by Redwood — Responsible: Redwood (Aisha / Security) — Target: 2027-03-07
- Milestone 3 — Lumen evidence collection & validation — Responsible: Lumen (Karen / Procurement) — Target: 2027-03-21
- Milestone 4 — Legal & procurement final review — Responsible: Lumen procurement / Redwood legal — Target: 2027-03-28
- Milestone 5 — Technical sign-off & pilot start — Responsible: Lumen eng / Redwood eng — Target: 2027-04-08 (target close date)

Key dependencies:
- Redwood to provide the SOC 2 questionnaire and a minimal evidence list (we propose sending the initial package by 3/7).
- Lumen needs to confirm a single point of contact for evidence collection and provide any existing vendor-assessment artifacts (if available).
- If Lumen requires additional third-party penetration test results, that may add ~2 weeks to the timeline.

Attachments included: MAP-draft-Lumen-20270228.xlsx (milestones + owners), Lumen-SOC2-Questions-v1.pdf (SOC 2 Qs).

Ask / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the target dates above or suggest adjustments?
2) Please confirm the Lumen evidence POC for procurement + security.
3) Rishi, can you confirm availability for a 60-minute technical kickoff this week (proposed: Thu 2/25 11am PT)?

Thanks — we want to keep the MAP tight and avoid open-ended review cycles.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: MAP-draft-Lumen-20270228.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
Attachment: Lumen-SOC2-Questions-v1.pdf (PDF, 12 pages)
From: Tom Briggs <tom@lumenhealth.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Karen Lee <karen.lee@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Lumen Health Procurement <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Security gate & SOC 2 package delivery (initial)

Aisha —

Appreciate the crisp plan and the schedule. Quick responses from our side:
- Dates generally look fine; the 3/7 delivery for Redwood's questionnaire works.
- I'll be the technical POC for the kickoff, Karen will own procurement coordination.
- Two asks: 1) Can you clarify whether the SOC 2 Qs you sent are the full workbook our procurement team expects, or is that a curated subset? 2) We will need a list of the minimal evidence artifacts (e.g., encryption configs, access control lists, SOC 2 report redaction options) to decide if we can deliver by 3/21.

On the kickoff: Thu 2/25 11am PT should work; I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Tom
Director, Engineering — Lumen Health

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: technical kickoff prep / SOC 2 evidence notes

Aisha / Neha / Dev —

Quick internal note following Tom's reply and to prep for the 2/25 kickoff:
- I'll own the technical Q&A and the security kickoff. Confirmed on the 11am PT slot.
- Action for Dev: please compile the following minimal artifacts to include with the SOC 2 package by 3/7: 
  * High-level architecture diagram (hosted regions, VPC boundaries)
  * Key management summary (KMS/HSM usage, rotation cadence)
  * Access control matrix for service accounts (last 90 days)
  * List of subprocessors and data flow notes (redacted where necessary)
- Neha: can you loop in Security (internal info-sec) to produce the redwood-soc2-summary.pdf and confirm which sections of the full SOC 2 report we can share redacted? We need that file no later than 3/5 so Aisha can attach it with the questionnaire on 3/7.

I'll also prepare a short FAQ for procurement on redaction and what evidence we can provide vs. what they should expect to request.

Rishi
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Note: internal only. No attachments in this note.

Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Updated MAP + SOC 2 package timeline (agree/confirm)

Tom / Karen —

Following the kickoff and internal alignment, please find the updated MAP and attachments. Changes from the initial draft:
- Moved the security kickoff to 2/25 (completed).
- Redwood will deliver the full SOC 2 questionnaire + minimal evidence list on 2027-03-07.
- Redwood will include a redacted SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) with the questionnaire to speed procurement review.
- If Lumen indicates any evidence gaps after 3/21, we'll agree a remediation plan and revised target close date (no earlier than 2027-04-22 if additional evidence collection is required).

Attachments (for visibility):
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (redacted report summary)
- MAP-draft-Lumen-20270228.xlsx (updated with 'completed' column)
- Lumen-SOC2-Questions-v1.pdf

Please reply with: 1) confirmation that Karen (or procurement@lumenhealth.com) will own the evidence collection, and 2) whether Lumen needs us to produce any additional compliance artifacts (pen test report, configuration screenshots) up front.

We'll also post the MAP and artifacts to the shared Drive (link below) and push a HubSpot update to DEAL-4982 so procurement and your internal stakeholders can track progress.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BzLumen/Map-Draft-4982
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-4982
DocuSign (for future SOW): https://www.docusign.com/REDACTED/doc/DEAL-4982

Thanks — aiming to keep this phase tightly scoped so legal/procurement can close quickly.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
